question: Under what condition must a teaching be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year?
premises: A teaching is fit to be given only in a specific case.
The recipient must be previously accomplished in practice.
The recipient must have been tested for one full year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: Nature of the test remains unspecified
plain_english: It is to be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
